review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions: truncatedModeFactor, occupationNormSq_smul, and the parallel proofs in Pair/EnergyReturn.lean. The file has no simp attributes and defines no simp-relevant lemmas of its own. I found no loops, competing rules or unwanted expansion. The only issue is a missing normal form for the real-coefficient smul norm. This is a modest finding. I did not check every caller of occupationNormSq_smul beyond the grep hits, and I did not run Lean. The `unfold truncatedModeFactor; split_ifs` step is a one-off use, so I did not recommend a simp lemma for it.

findings.excerpt:
rw [occupationNormSq_smul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ pairFactor Q p from Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] at he
findings.problem: occupationNormSq_smul is not tagged simp, and no lemma gives the canonical form of occupationNormSq Q ((r:ℝ):ℂ) • x). Each caller therefore rewrites the whole chain by hand: occupationNormSq_smul, then Complex.norm_real, then Real.norm_eq_abs, then abs_of_nonneg with a side goal. The same four-step chain appears in Pair/EnergyReturn.lean (pair_energy_return). Other callers pass occupationNormSq_smul by name to `simp only`. The simp set does not reduce `occupationNormSq Q (((r:ℝ):ℂ) • x)` to `r^2 * occupationNormSq Q x`, so every use needs a bespoke rw sequence.
findings.proposed_change: Next to occupationNormSq_smul, add a lemma `occupationNormSq_ofReal_smul (Q) (r : ℝ) (x : Space Q) : occupationNormSq Q ((r : ℂ) • x) = r^2 * occupationNormSq Q x`. Its proof is occupationNormSq_smul followed by Complex.norm_real and `sq_abs`. This needs no sign hypothesis. Mark it @[simp], and consider @[simp] on occupationNormSq_smul too. Both have a strictly smaller right-hand side, so they cannot loop. The `rw ... at he` blocks in both files then become a single rewrite, and the abs_of_nonneg side goal disappears.
findings.benefit: The `‖c‖^2 * _` form that simp produces becomes the standard normal form for scaled occupation norms. Users no longer rebuild the norm_real/abs/sqrt-nonneg chain, and the two parallel proofs lose that duplicated step.

evidence.excerpt:
theorem occupationNormSq_smul (Q : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : Space Q) :
    occupationNormSq Q (c • x) = ‖c‖^2 * occupationNormSq Q x := by
